## GUESS example

For a $12.0\ \mathrm{V}$ rail carrying $3.25\ \mathrm{A}$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
P &= VI \\
  &= (12.0\ \mathrm{V})(3.25\ \mathrm{A}) \\
  &= 39.00000\ \mathrm{W} \\
  &= 39.0\ \mathrm{W}
\end{aligned}
$$

The final result has three significant figures. On the Casio fx-991ES PLUS C, enter `12.0 × 3.25 =`.

## Lab L22 preparation

Trace one power path and one data path without disconnecting anything. Record connector type, keying, latch, destination, and purpose. A PSU wattage is a capacity rating, not a live measurement of present use.

Never force keyed connectors or probe inside an energized computer.
